config_coupling.effect: The installer places its data root at data_home/concord and its stable release link at data_home/concord/current. With no explicit root, an XDG_DATA_HOME containing /opencode-projects/ is diagnosed as a session shard and replaced by HOME/.local/share. This installer rule does not change the store's DefaultPath resolver.
config_coupling.source: Without an explicit installer root, os.environ.get reads XDG_DATA_HOME with HOME/.local/share as the absent-key default. An explicit root instead resolves a sandbox home and uses its data, config and bin children.
